role: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SSDET)
description: Leading quality engineering and test automation initiatives for Kroger's large-scale retail ecosystem across iOS and Android platforms. Contributing to multiple customer-facing mobile applications and features used by millions of shoppers.
responsibilities: Designed, developed, and maintained scalable automation frameworks for iOS and Android applications using Appium, XCUITest, Espresso, Java, Kotlin, and Swift
Built and executed end-to-end automation suites for critical customer journeys — improving regression coverage and release confidence
Automated UI, API, and integration test scenarios using Rest Assured, reducing manual testing efforts and accelerating release cycles
Collaborated closely with Product Managers, Developers, Business Analysts, and QA teams in Agile/Scrum environments
Integrated automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions for continuous quality validation
Conducted accessibility, functional, regression, smoke, and end-to-end testing across multiple mobile platforms
Participated in sprint planning, requirement reviews, defect triage, production validation, and release sign-off activities
Mentored team members on automation best practices, framework design, and mobile testing strategies

awards.name: Pivot Polaris Prize
awards.description: Recognised as Best Performer at ZopSmart Technologies — awarded for outstanding contribution to quality engineering and delivery excellence.

achievements: 5+ years supporting Kroger Technology initiatives across multiple iOS and Android teams
Automated critical customer journeys used by millions of retail customers across the USA
Built and maintained scalable mobile automation frameworks supporting enterprise applications
Leveraged AI-assisted tools and LLMs for test case generation, automation development, and QA documentation

initiatives.name: Shopping List & Personalization
initiatives.description: Automated Shopping List creation, management, item updates, synchronization, and user engagement workflows. Validated cross-platform user experiences and backend integrations.

initiatives.name: Account & Customer Experience
initiatives.description: Automated Login, Registration, Authentication, Profile Management, and Customer Preference features. Performed API and UI validation for secure customer-facing experiences.

initiatives.name: Accessibility & Quality Initiatives
initiatives.description: Introduced accessibility validation practices into testing workflows. Automated accessibility checks for customer-facing mobile experiences supporting inclusive digital products.
